title: Solidarisches Handeln in krisenhaften Zeiten
summary: Times of crisis - times of danger and change: Crises pose challenges at both a societal and individual level and trigger processes of reorientation. This raises the question of solidarity and democracy in particular: common problems must be dealt with collectively or individual interests must be put aside to protect others. What role does solidarity play in the crisis? Is solidarity itself in crisis? What prerequisites are necessary for a practice of solidarity from a social work perspective? The articles examine the challenges for individuals and society based on international examples and collect possible solutions.
